opening_message:
Ticket 1: Christopher Myers (employee ID E012) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E012.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Christopher Myers (E012) is a contractor Analyst. Contractors may have read, or write only if they have advanced security training. HR has no record of advanced training, so I recommend read; write should only be granted if Security confirms advanced training.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security confirms Christopher Myers (E012) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors need advanced training for write; basic training limits them to read. Requested write exceeds the maximum, so I recommend read.
reason: Christopher Myers (E012) is a contractor with basic security training (confirmed by Security). Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training; write is never allowed without it, and admin is never allowed. Since the requested write exceeds the maximum of read, the maximum (read) is granted.

Requested write > maximum (read). So grant maximum = read.

Let me submit decision: read.
